_comment: Copy this file to config/license.json and fill in the keys you own.
NEVER commit config/license.json - it is gitignored.
Three different keys belong to three different components:
runtime.licenseKey      -> SpreadJS core, validated in the BROWSER. Free on localhost/127.0.0.1.
designer.licenseKey     -> SpreadJS Designer, validated in the BROWSER. Only needed for Designer pages.
server.serverLicenseKey -> js-collaboration SERVER, validated on the server, bound to this machine's id.
The mirror (zero-license) implementation needs none of them.
The official implementation (impl=real) needs server.serverLicenseKey; it is machine-bound,
so run `npm run doctor` to print your machine id before requesting one from GrapeCity.
